problem: A documentation/borging PR could reach delivery admission with Candidate-Type: closure even though closure is not part of the machine delivery contract, causing a preventable metadata block and another CI cycle.
root_cause: PR metadata creation allowed semantic prose to leak into a closed machine enum; parseDeliveryMetadata lowercased values but did not canonicalize the known docs-only closure alias before validation.
fix: Canonicalize Candidate-Type closure to docs only when Delivery-Lane is docs, keep closure invalid for every other lane, and require agents/chats to emit the canonical docs value at PR creation.
failed_approaches: Letting the admission gate discover the invalid alias after CI already started.
Treating Candidate-Type as free-form descriptive text instead of a machine enum.
Opening a replacement PR or bypassing validation instead of correcting the same lineage.
prevention: Use Candidate-Type: docs for documentation, borging, learning and ledger-only changes.
Normalize the legacy closure alias before admission only for Delivery-Lane: docs.
Keep all unknown or cross-lane aliases fail-closed.
After metadata correction, continue on the same PR/obligation lineage.
